name: Coat
soul: The soul of someone who keeps themselves to themselves; who is always dressed to leave, and is warm to very few.
spark: The mote gets inside your collar when it rains, and you are drier than you should be.

hybrid.text: It is around you before the weather is.

settled.name: Clasp
settled.text: A coat's clasp and the scrap of cloth it still holds, kept in a pocket. It is warm when you are not, and it remembers the rest of the coat.
settled.sign: A brass clasp holding a thumb's width of grey cloth, with one small eye in the metal.
settled.habit: It is warm in your pocket on cold days, and it closes itself when you button up.

paths.name: Travelling Coat
paths.of: one who is happiest between places
paths.text: It learned from you that home is whatever you have on when the weather turns.
paths.sign: A long coat with a turned-up collar, and dust on the hem from somewhere else.
paths.habit: It hangs by the door, never in the wardrobe, with one sleeve already toward the latch.

prongs.name: Oilskin
prongs.of: one who goes whatever the weather and complains only afterwards
prongs.text: It has gone slick and dark and sheds the river. It would like you to stop falling in all the same.
prongs.sign: Slick and dark, and water stands on it in beads.
prongs.habit: It shakes itself like a dog when it comes in, away from you.

finishes.name: Pilot's Coat
finishes.of: one who knows the deep water by the drag of it
finishes.text: It knows the channel by how its hem drags, and pulls you toward the deep water or away from it, as needed.
finishes.sign: A hem that moves as if there were a current in the room.
finishes.habit: It leans toward the river from wherever it is hung.

finishes.name: The Lent Coat
finishes.of: one who gives away what they are wearing
finishes.text: It goes round whoever you are bringing home and leaves you in your shirt. They arrive dry. You arrive.
finishes.sign: It is on someone else's shoulders more often than yours.
finishes.habit: It goes round whoever in the room is shivering, and comes back when they have stopped.

prongs.name: Road-coat
prongs.of: one who has stopped counting the miles
prongs.text: It has taken the grey of line dust and stopped showing the miles.
prongs.sign: The grey of line dust all over, and a long stride in the way it hangs.
prongs.habit: It sways on its hook at the pace of walking.

finishes.name: Thousand-mile Coat
finishes.of: one whom every lineman on the road already knows
finishes.text: It has walked the line end to end and its hem is all post-marks. Linemen nod to it before they nod to you.
finishes.sign: A hem covered in post-marks, stamped one over another.
finishes.habit: It nods its collar to anyone in line colours.

finishes.name: Many Pockets
finishes.of: one who never comes back from anywhere empty-handed
finishes.text: It has a pocket for everything you pick up and several you did not sew. Things you lost last season turn up in them.
finishes.sign: More pockets than you sewed, and some of them are occupied.
finishes.habit: It produces things when needed: string, a candle end, a biscuit of uncertain age.

prongs.name: Hide-coat
prongs.of: one who has been out long enough to stop looking like the people at home
prongs.text: Out past the posts it has grown a pelt, and smells of it.
prongs.sign: A pelt has grown through the cloth at the shoulders.
prongs.habit: Indoors it is restless and sheds. Outdoors it is neither.

finishes.name: Winter Coat
finishes.of: one who is their own shelter
finishes.text: Alone in the cold it is tent and bed and the only company. It has kept you alive on nights that had other plans.
finishes.sign: Frost on the collar that does not melt by the fire.
finishes.habit: It wraps itself round you a little tighter each hour after midnight.

finishes.name: Deep-coat
finishes.of: one who holds their breath and goes further down
finishes.text: Far under, it pads itself against stone and holds its breath where the air is bad, and you hold yours.
finishes.sign: Padded at the elbows and shoulders with something like stone.
finishes.habit: It goes stiff and still in close rooms, and you find you are breathing shallow too.

paths.name: Shadow-coat
paths.of: one who would rather not be noticed
paths.text: It learned from you that the best place for a blow to land is where you just were.
paths.sign: It is hard to say what colour it is. You notice the gap where it hangs first.
paths.habit: It hangs in the corner of the room that nobody looks at. Every room has one.

prongs.name: Slip-coat
prongs.of: one who is never where the hand closes
prongs.text: Hands close on it and find it empty. You are a step to the left, as usual.
prongs.sign: Sleek and close-cut, with nothing to take hold of.
prongs.habit: It slides off any hook but its own.

finishes.name: Empty Sleeve
finishes.of: one who leaves a little of themselves behind in every argument
finishes.text: It leaves a sleeve where you were, and the sleeve takes the blow. It grows another by morning.
finishes.sign: One sleeve hangs flat, and it is not always the same one.
finishes.habit: It leaves a sleeve over the back of your chair so that the chair looks taken.

finishes.name: Knife-coat
finishes.of: one who is quiet and should not be mistaken for harmless
finishes.text: There is a blade in the lining now and the coat knows when you want it. It puts the hilt in your hand as you turn.
finishes.sign: A hard straight line in the lining, a hand long.
finishes.habit: It turns its lined side inward when friends are near, and outward otherwise.

prongs.name: Night-coat
prongs.of: one who comes alive when everyone else has gone to bed
prongs.text: After dark it takes the colour of whatever is behind you.
prongs.sign: By day an ordinary grey. After dusk, the colour of whatever is behind you.
prongs.habit: It is off its hook when you wake in the night, and back when you wake in the morning.

finishes.name: Collar-up
finishes.of: one who can tell when they are being looked at
finishes.text: It turns its collar up when something in the dark is looking at you. It has not once done it for the wind.
finishes.sign: A collar that stands up by itself, sometimes.
finishes.habit: It turns its collar up in certain company. It has never been wrong about the company.

finishes.name: Nobody's Coat
finishes.of: one who crosses a room and leaves no account of themselves
finishes.text: In it you are someone people remember meeting and cannot describe. Quiet places stay quiet when you cross them.
finishes.sign: You have looked straight at it and could not say afterwards what it looked like.
finishes.habit: It hangs among other coats, and you have to count to find it.

prongs.name: Turncoat
prongs.of: one who shows a different side when hurt
prongs.text: It wears your element on the inside and turns itself out when you are hit.
prongs.sign: A plain outside, and a lining the colour of your element.
prongs.habit: It turns itself inside out on the hook when you come home in a temper.

finishes.name: Storm-lined
finishes.of: one who holds weather inside and opens the coat rarely
finishes.text: The lining is weather now. Opened on the last beat of your chain it lets all of it out at once.
finishes.sign: The lining moves. Put your hand in and there is wind.
finishes.habit: On still days it opens a finger's width and the curtains stir.

finishes.name: Scorched Hem
finishes.of: one who has lost a little to every blow and is harder for it
finishes.text: Every blow that reached you burned a little of it away. What is left is short, black, and very hard to hurt.
finishes.sign: Short now, black at every edge, and stiff as hide.
finishes.habit: It will not hang near the fire. It keeps to the cold end of the room.

paths.name: Listening Coat
paths.of: one who is told things, and keeps them
paths.text: It learned from you that a coat hangs in every room worth listening in.
paths.sign: A collar shaped like the rim of an ear.
paths.habit: It hangs nearest the door of whichever room has people talking in it.

prongs.name: Clerk's Coat
prongs.of: one who dresses for the office they mean to be given
prongs.text: It has gone a respectable black and learned to stand where the Hall can see it.
prongs.sign: A respectable black, with brass buttons it polishes itself.
prongs.habit: It brushes itself down before anyone important arrives. It knows before you do.

finishes.name: Coat of Offices
finishes.of: one whose record walks into the room ahead of them
finishes.text: Every writ you served is a button on it. Doors open for the buttons before anyone has looked at your face.
finishes.sign: A button for every writ served, in two long rows, each stamped differently.
finishes.habit: It counts its buttons at night, top to bottom, and is content.

finishes.name: Sworn Cloth
finishes.of: one who carries their promise where only they can read it
finishes.text: Your oath is stitched in the lining where only you can read it. The coat reads it back to you when you waver.
finishes.sign: Fine stitching inside the left breast that cannot be read from outside.
finishes.habit: It lies across your knees when you are wavering, lining up.

prongs.name: Whisper-collar
prongs.of: one who is always half listening to the next room
prongs.text: Its collar sits against your ear and tells you things a moment before they matter.
prongs.sign: Fine whiskers of thread along the collar's edge that stir at sounds.
prongs.habit: It lifts its collar toward conversations in the next room.

finishes.name: The Warning Tug
finishes.of: one who pulls a friend's sleeve at the right moment
finishes.text: It pulls your sleeve the instant before a blow, and your arm is already where it should be. You have stopped thanking it.
finishes.sign: One cuff is worn thin where it takes hold of your wrist.
finishes.habit: It tugs when you are about to speak out of turn. You have learned to stop.

finishes.name: Eavesdropper
finishes.of: one who hears everything and decides what you need to know
finishes.text: Left on a hook in another room it hears everything, and tells you later in the order it thinks you should know.
finishes.sign: It hangs perfectly still, with its collar spread wide.
finishes.habit: Left in a room, it is on a different hook when you return: the one nearer the talk.

prongs.name: Hand-me-down
prongs.of: one who is made of what other people left them
prongs.text: It has started to fit other people, some of whom are not here any more.
prongs.sign: Mended in four different hands. You can tell the stitches apart.
prongs.habit: It smells, some days, of a house you have never lived in.

finishes.name: Inherited Coat
finishes.of: one who stands the way someone before them stood
finishes.text: A shade wore it first, in a way. Some evenings it still stands as they stood, and you find yourself standing so too.
finishes.sign: It hangs with the shoulders set as if someone taller were wearing it.
finishes.habit: Some evenings it stands by the hearth by itself, the way they used to.

finishes.name: Coat of the Cohort
finishes.of: one whom twelve people have borrowed from and none has forgotten
finishes.text: Every classmate has borrowed it and it kept something of each. It fits all twelve, and it is warmest when you are together.
finishes.sign: Twelve small marks inside the collar, one from each.
finishes.habit: It goes from peg to peg along the hall through the night. Each of them wakes warm.
